title: Explorer Index
prompt:
Write `createExplorer(records)` where each record has at least `{ id, score }`. It RETURNS an object with:

- `byId(id)` — the record with that id, or `null` (build a Map once, up front)
- `count()` — the number of records
- `top(n)` — the first `n` records sorted by score, highest first; ties keep their original order; if there are fewer than `n`, return them all

tests.name: byId finds records and returns null for unknown ids
tests.hint: const index = new Map(records.map((r) => [r.id, r])); then index.get(id) ?? null.

tests.name: count returns the record count
top sorts by score desc and is stable for ties
tests.hint: Map records to { r, i } pairs, sort by (score desc, then index asc), slice, and unwrap.
